boss.funds_off_body: The balance and transactions appear here when a supported banking resource is running.
boss.balance_unavailable: The society account balance could not be read.
boss.no_tx_body: Deposits, withdrawals and other society payments will show up here.
boss.no_employees_body: Nobody works here yet. Hire someone from the Hiring page.
boss.lock_self: You cannot change your own rank or employment.
boss.lock_rank: You can only manage employees below your own rank.
boss.promote_none: No higher rank you can assign
boss.fire_confirm_body: %s (%s) will lose this job immediately. To bring them back you would have to hire them again.
boss.hiring_explain: People standing near this computer who don't already work for %s are listed here. They get a prompt to accept or decline - nobody joins without saying yes.
boss.hiring_explain_id: People standing near this computer who don't already work for %s are listed here, and anyone else can be reached by their player ID. Either way they get a prompt to accept or decline - nobody joins without saying yes.
boss.nearby_empty_body: Ask the person you want to hire to stand next to this computer, then select Refresh.
boss.nearby_empty_body_id: Ask the person you want to hire to stand next to this computer, then select Refresh. Or send the offer to their player ID below.
boss.byid_hint: For someone who is not at this computer. Ask them for their ID: the offer reaches them wherever they are, and you see their name once they accept.
boss.deposit_caption: Move your own money into the society account.
boss.withdraw_caption: Take money out of the society account.
